alkylation_reagent: Carbamidomethylation of cysteine was set as a fixed modification and oxidation of methionine as a variable modification.
cleavage_agent: These protein spots were manually cut from the gels, digested in-gel with trypsin (PROMEGA), and further identified by MS.
instrument: The cleared peptide digests were analyzed using a Q-Exactive HF Hybrid quadrupole-Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Hemel Hempstead, UK) coupled to a Dionex Ultimate 3000 RSLC nano-liquid chromatography (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Hemel Hempstead, UK).
ionization_type: inferred: The Q-Exactive HF is coupled to a Dionex Ultimate 3000 RSLC nano-liquid chromatography, which utilizes electrospray ionization (ESI) standard for such systems, distinct from the MALDI or specific ESI mentions in the 2-DE section.
labeling: Shotgun proteomics was based on two-dimensional gel electrophoresis (2-DE) along with mass spectrometry identification, and shotgun proteomics with label-free quantification.
